answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24318 Country: India Title: Is barber work is "Halal" or "haram"? Question: Is barber work is "Halal" or "haram"? Answer ID: 24318 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1185/1185/M=1431) If a barber cuts lawful hair, his income is not haram. It is unlawful to cut and shave the hair of beard, consequently, the income earned through it is not halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
